Job Summary

This position is responsible for day-to-day execution of Business Ethics & Integrity and Forensic Audit functions. Responsibilities cover the technical execution on company’s anti-fraud, anti-bribery, and anti-corruption initiatives development and monitoring over Bribery Risk and Fraud Risk Assessments, Conflict of Interest, Gift & Entertainment transactions, and Sponsorship & Donation transactions. This role works under direct guidance and supervision from the Business Ethics and Integrity Manager.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Identify, develop, and monitor Fraud Risk Assessment and Bribery Risk Assessment, while provide regular and timely updates to Head of Forensic and Investigation.

Successfully embedding FRA to existing ERM.

Responsible for day-to-day execution of company's ABMS and anti-fraud initiatives.

ABMS is effectively implemented.

Responsible for maintaining company's Whistleblowing channel.

Timely reporting to Head of Forensic and Investigation on monitoring and review results.

Promote awareness of the company's ABMS and anti-fraud initiatives through training and socialization to employees and third parties.

Training and socialization program with relevant topics and targeted audience

Responsible to ensure integrity aspects related to people mapping, especially for organization critical positions, should be aligned with integrity principal, collaborate with related parties in Human Capital Function
Timely review and approval of Employee Integrity Checklist

Lead and perform fact-finding investigation on reported allegations
Assigned task completed in timely and accurate manne

Take an active role as role model to provide guide in upholding ethics and integrity
Zero tolerance to fraud

- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

Bachelor's Degree of Accounting/Finance/forensic-related field

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Min 3 years experience as an Auditor, Investigator, Compliance, or related field
• Have familiarity with accounting principles, corporate governance, Anti-Bribery Management System (ISO37001), whistleblowing systems (ISO37002), data analytics, fact-finding investigations or similar tasks
• Knowledge and awareness, including enforcement trends for International Anti-Bribery/corruption related regulations like the FCPA, UK Bribery Act
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skill
• Excellent communication, presentation, and report writing skill
• Fluent in English (written and verbal)
• Attention to detail

Certification

wo-jpfa-JR3092.d:
• Perencanaan dan Pengadaan

1. Menyusun rencana pengadaan berdasarkan kebutuhan operasional dan anggaran yang telah disetujui.

2. Memastikan seluruh permintaan pembelian (Purchase Requisition/PR) diproses sesuai prosedur dan target waktu yang ditetapkan.

3. Melakukan sourcing, seleksi, dan evaluasi vendor/supplier untuk mendapatkan kualitas, harga, dan layanan terbaik.

4. Memastikan proses permintaan penawaran harga (RFQ), negosiasi, dan penunjukan vendor dilakukan secara transparan dan sesuai kebijakan perusahaan.

5. Mengelola proses pembuatan dan penerbitan Purchase Order (PO).

• Pengelolaan Vendor dan Kontrak

1. Membangun dan menjaga hubungan kerja yang baik dengan supplier/vendor.

2. Melakukan evaluasi kinerja supplier secara berkala berdasarkan aspek kualitas, harga, ketepatan pengiriman, dan pelayanan.

3. Melakukan negosiasi harga, syarat pembayaran, kontrak, dan ketentuan kerja sama untuk mendapatkan keuntungan optimal bagi perusahaan.

4. Mengelola dan memonitor masa berlaku kontrak serta melakukan pembaruan apabila diperlukan.

• Pengendalian Biaya dan Kepatuhan

1. Mengidentifikasi peluang efisiensi biaya pengadaan melalui strategi sourcing dan negosiasi yang efektif.

2. Memastikan seluruh aktivitas pengadaan mematuhi SOP, kebijakan perusahaan, prinsip Good Corporate Governance (GCG), dan peraturan yang berlaku.

3. Mengawasi dokumentasi pengadaan agar lengkap, akurat, dan mudah ditelusuri untuk kebutuhan audit.

• Monitoring dan Pelaporan

1. Memantau status pengadaan dan pengiriman barang/jasa untuk memastikan kebutuhan pengguna terpenuhi tepat waktu.

2. Menyusun laporan pengadaan secara berkala meliputi realisasi pembelian, penghematan biaya (cost saving), kinerja supplier, dan kendala operasional.

3. Menganalisis data pengadaan sebagai dasar rekomendasi perbaikan proses dan efisiensi.

• Kepemimpinan Tim

1. Mengarahkan, membina, dan mengembangkan kompetensi staf Procurement.

2. Melakukan monitoring kinerja tim dan memastikan target kerja tercapai.

3. Mendorong penerapan budaya kerja yang profesional, kolaboratif, dan berorientasi pada pelayanan internal.

Job Summary:**

PT Japfa Food Indonesia is seeking motivated and dedicated individuals to join our team as Food Staff. This role involves contributing to the efficient and safe production, processing, or handling of food products within our facilities.

Job Description

As a Staff member at a PT Japfa Food Indonesia, you will be responsible for ensuring smooth daily operations and compiling accurate administrative reports. Key responsibilities include:

• Operational Supervision: Monitor daily processes (production/distribution/quality) to ensure they run according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and the company's daily targets.
• Administration & Reporting: Record, summarize, and analyze daily data (e.g., production yields, raw material/finished goods stock levels, or lab test results). Create periodic daily, weekly, and monthly reports.
• Cross-Divisional Coordination: Collaborate effectively with other departments such as Warehouse/Stockist, Maintenance, and Laboratory to resolve operational constraints or anomalies in raw materials/products.

Job Qualifications

• Minimum Education: Diploma (D3) or Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Food Technology, Industrial Engineering, Animal Husbandry/Agriculture, Biology, Management, or other related fields.
• Experience: Fresh graduates are welcome to apply, but having 1-2 years of experience in the FMCG, agrifood, or food manufacturing industry is a strong plus.
• Industry Knowledge: Strong foundational knowledge of food quality and safety standards (HACCP, GMP, SSOP).
• Technical Skills (Hard Skills):
• Proficient in using Microsoft Office (especially Excel for data processing and reporting).
• Familiarity with ERP systems (such as SAP or Oracle) is a plus.
• Interpersonal Skills (Soft Skills):
• Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Detail-oriented, meticulous, and able to work quickly in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
• Strong communication skills for effective cross-team coordination.
• Availability: Willing to work in a shift system (if assigned to factory operations) and be placed in the operational/factory area.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
